# fco_managed_vm_vlans (Data Source)

Lists all VLANs available to the tenant in a datacenter location, optionally filtered by `domain_uuid`.

Access the results via `fco_managed_vm_vlans.<name>.vlans`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List VLANs available to the tenant in a datacenter location.
# `location_uuid` is required; `domain_uuid` is an optional filter.
data "fco_managed_vm_vlans" "in_location" {
  location_uuid = data.fco_managed_vm_locations.all.locations[0].uuid
}

# Access with `fco_managed_vm_vlans.in_location.vlans`.
# e.g. fco_managed_vm_vlans.in_location.vlans[0].uuid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_uuid` (String) The UUID of the datacenter location to list VLANs for. This is required by the API.

### Optional

- `domain_uuid` (String) Only return VLANs associated with this Windows domain.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed VLANs.
- `vlans` (Attributes List) The list of VLANs available to the tenant in the given location, optionally filtered by `domain_uuid`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans))

<a id="nestedatt--vlans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans`

Read-Only:

- `domain_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Windows domain this VLAN is associated with, if any.
- `location_uuid` (String) The UUID of the location this VLAN belongs to.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) The CIDR of the subnet this VLAN belongs to.
- `subnet_title` (String) The title of the subnet this VLAN belongs to, including the stage type.
- `tenant` (String) The tenant this VLAN belongs to.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the VLAN.
- `vlan_id` (Number) The VLAN ID a network interface is attached to.
